the Android file picker, opened on the Downloads folder, with tou-jin-zi.zip selected - the bundle the PC Legends page for 偷金子 (Lode Runner) offers
the Files panel again, now with tou-jin-zi installed - its entry point LR.COM, its size, and the Play / States / Launch… / Remove buttons

Game Mode over the running game - the 8-way d-pad, L-CLICK and R-CLICK, the trackball, CTRL as fire and ALT as strafe - with the game still running behind the pads
back to the plain keyboard pads after the reverse Konami code (↑↑↓↓←→←→, then X and Y) - the game is still running underneath

back in the game after tapping the notification - the same frame, the same score - nothing was lost while the app was in the background
the DOSBox welcome banner and the C:\> prompt, with the two-pad on-screen keyboard below it
